verdict.rationale: Brevo's own developer docs say it integrates with AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol, letting AI models act on a Brevo account through standardized endpoints. The pricing page adds that campaigns and contacts can be managed from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools, so this is a first-party MCP offering. missing for 10: setup and connection details (endpoint URL, auth flow), a list of exposed tools and their scope, and independent or hands-on proof that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Integrate Brevo with AI assistants using the Model Context Protocol. Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
